# Kav-UI CSS snapshot

Source: /home/kaito/workspaces/design-catalog/assets/css
Revision: 3c392b754aa2ba0b5ae9d56c367c43237dfadee6
Package version: 0.1.0 (private, not published to npm)

CSS is copied unchanged with its import tree, following the repository README's
asset-copy installation. No runtime JS is included: Vue owns interactive state.
The application stylesheet expands ui.css imports as string imports in a CSS layer,
because Tailwind does not inline upstream url() imports in a layer. CSS source files
remain unchanged.
This snapshot has no dependency on directories outside this repository.
To update, review the source revision and replace the complete css directory.
Kav-UI's own license is not yet determined (packages/core/README.md).
